reference.title: tagdictionary-Or
reference.shortdesc: Or is one of several possible validity conditions subproperties, which are used to specify a certain criteria to be met in order for a tag to be applied to an object.

section.p: For the Or condition, if the target object has any of the conditions listed under the Or property, the parent definition's tag(s) may be applied.

The example below shows the And tag rule which contains the condition And with these additional combined conditions: And and Or. In this case, if all of the And criteria plus any of the Or criteria are met, the parent definition’s tag(s) may be applied.
